visit_history.note: Follow-up for T2DM. A1c improved from 8.4 to 7.8 on current metformin dose. BP still mildly elevated. Continue current meds, recheck labs in 3 months. Discussed diet and exercise.
New complaint of right knee pain, worse with stairs. No swelling or instability on exam. X-ray ordered. Started acetaminophen PRN.
Annual physical. Reviewed medication list, no changes. Flu vaccine given. Labs ordered for next visit.
Reports increased anxiety related to work stress, sleep disrupted. Sertraline increased from 25mg to 50mg. Follow-up in 4 weeks, referral to counseling offered and accepted.
Seasonal allergy flare, nasal congestion, mild wheeze with exertion. Advised to resume fluticasone daily during pollen season. Albuterol refilled.
Routine visit, doing well, no acute complaints. Continue current regimen.
Cardiology follow-up for AFib, rate well controlled on metoprolol. INR/renal function stable. Continue apixaban, no bleeding events reported. eGFR stable at 48.
Routine labs reviewed, LDL at goal on atorvastatin. Renal function stable, CKD stage 3 monitored. No new symptoms.
Presented with palpitations, found to be in new-onset AFib. Started on apixaban and metoprolol. Referred to cardiology.
Migraine frequency improved, now 1-2 per month vs weekly. Sumatriptan effective when taken early. Hgb rechecked, improved to 10.8 from 9.6. Continue iron supplementation.
Fatigue and pallor noted, labs showed iron deficiency anemia (Hgb 9.6). Started ferrous sulfate, dietary counseling given.
New diagnosis of migraine with aura after recurrent episodes of visual disturbance and headache. Started sumatriptan PRN.
Weight stable, discussed CPAP compliance which patient reports is good (~6 hrs/night). GERD symptoms controlled on omeprazole. Repeat A1c ordered given prediabetes.
Sleep study confirmed moderate OSA. CPAP prescribed. Weight loss counseling provided, referral to nutrition.
Annual physical. A1c 5.9%, borderline prediabetes range. GERD symptoms reported, started omeprazole.
